sections.title: Card component and hover lift
sections.what: Creates the card component. It renders as a section when an aria-label is given, and it can add a lift effect on hover.
sections.why: Likely reason: a section element helps screen readers when a card has a label.
sections.watch_out: Adding an aria-label switches the element type, which can change how stylesheets that target divs apply.

summary: The shared white card container used to show medical data across the app, with choices for padding, corner roundness and style.
purpose: Keeps all data cards looking the same.
why: Header says premium container for medical data. Likely reason: visual consistency.
how: Defines style choices for color, padding and corner roundness, with defaults. Renders a section element instead of a div when an aria-label is given, and can add a lift effect on hover.
inputs: Variant, padding, radius, hoverEffect, class name, and the usual div props.
outputs: A card element on the page.
risks: The defaults apply to every card that does not set its own, so changing a default restyles the whole app. Adding an aria-label silently changes the element type.
debug: If a card looks wrong, check its variant and padding props. If a card is styled differently when it has a label, the element type change is the likely cause.
